sets.name: sakura
sets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite sheet for a Windows desktop falling-leaves pixel-art app. Generate a single square sprite sheet containing EXACTLY FOUR isolated pink sakura cherry blossom PETALS (individual petals, never full flowers) in a strict 2 by 2 grid. Each quadrant must be equivalent to exactly 16 by 16 logical pixels, drawn as a tiny authentic game sprite, enlarged with nearest-neighbor giant square pixels; the entire sheet therefore has a strict 32 by 32 logical pixel grid. Each sprite occupies approximately 10 to 13 pixels within its 16x16 cell, leaving at least 2 fully transparent logical pixels on each side. Variant top left: pale pink heart-notched petal, top right: rose pink curved oval petal, bottom left: blush pink teardrop petal, bottom right: warm pink folded petal. Each is just ONE petal with 4 to 6 discrete pink tones, subtle raspberry one-pixel outline and a very small pale highlight. Crisp stepped silhouettes and tiny pixel clusters, absolutely NO antialiasing, gradients, blur, glow, shadows, photography, stems, branches, background scenes, text, grid lines, labels or watermarks. True transparent background including all gutters. Sprites must remain beautiful and readable at genuine 16x16 resolution. Top-down simple flat game asset style, consistent scale.
